title: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon
summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, adding multimodal input capabilities across text, code, audio, video, and PDF with a one-million token context window at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
research_notes:
Obtain API credentials for the Gemini API and configure client access for the multimodal endpoint.

Format input requests including text, code, audio, video, or PDF data within the supported one-million token context limit.

Monitor token usage carefully when submitting dense multimodal payloads such as video or high-volume PDF files to manage input costs at $3 per million tokens.

Take advantage of the one-million token context window to submit complete code repositories and reference documents in a single prompt rather than fragmenting context.
